tagline: The old stage road, and the first First Lady's church.
intro: New Kent Highway was Route 33 until the interstate came through, and much of it roughly follows the old Richmond-Williamsburg Stage Road. The byway takes it from the roundabout at Talleysville east past Carps Corner to the courthouse village of New Kent and on to Angelview Church. At Talleysville, Old Church Road heads north toward White House, and from Carps Corner, Old River Road loops off by Tunstall Station and comes back to it near Talleysville.
Both armies made heavy use of the stage road in 1862, during the Peninsula Campaign.

moments.title: Crump's Mill
moments.text: Near Talleysville, Crump's Mill, an 1870s frame mill that ground until 1955, sits behind the dam of an L-shaped millpond on private land.

moments.title: St. Peter's Church
moments.text: Finished in 1703, St. Peter's had Union horses stabled in its pews, and its rector married Martha Custis to George Washington in 1759, wherever the ceremony actually took place.
